info.title: http2prefix — IP Address & ASN Lookup API
info.description:
Resolves IP addresses to BGP AS numbers (prefix2as) and AS numbers to announced IP prefixes (as2prefix).

Two MMDB databases are built automatically from gzipped CSVs fetched from the letstool CDN and refreshed once per day at noon (local time):
- **prefix2as** — `https://cdn.letstool.net/prefix2as/csv` (`prefix,origins` — origins is space-separated ASNs) (`prefix,origins` — origins is space-separated ASNs)
- **as2prefix** — `https://cdn.letstool.net/as2prefix/csv` (`asn,prefixes,peers,upstreams,downstreams` — values are space-separated; peers/upstreams/downstreams are merged into a single sorted peer list) (`asn,prefixes` — prefixes is space-separated CIDRs)

The produced MMDBs use the **same format as db2prefix** and are fully interchangeable with it.

A single endpoint (`POST /api/v1/asprefix`) auto-detects the query type:
- **IP address** (IPv4 or IPv6) → queries the `prefix2as` database
- **AS number** (e.g. `AS13335`, case-insensitive) → queries the `as2prefix` database

post.summary: Look up an IP address or AS number
post.description:
Accepts a **single query** containing either an IP address or an AS number.

**Query type detection:**
- If the query is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address → routes to the `prefix2as` database.
- If the query matches `AS<number>` (case-insensitive) → routes to the `as2prefix` database.

405.description: Method not allowed — only POST is accepted

get.summary: Download the current prefix2as.mmdb database file
get.description: Serves the current `prefix2as.mmdb` binary for peer instances.

get.summary: Download the current as2prefix.mmdb database file
get.description: Serves the current `as2prefix.mmdb` binary for peer instances.
Browser-based interface for IP and AS number lookup. Supports dark/light themes and 9 languages with RTL support.

query.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or AS number in the format `AS<number>` (case-insensitive). Examples: `"1.1.1.1"`, `"2606:4700::"`, `"AS13335"`, `"as15169"`.

status.description: SUCCESS: matched a record. NOTFOUND: valid query but no record. ERROR: malformed or DB not ready.

query_type.description: Detected query type. 'ip' for IP queries, 'asnum' for AS number queries.

answer.description: Present on SUCCESS and NOTFOUND. Schema depends on query_type.

IPAnswer.description: Answer for an IP address query (prefix2as lookup). A prefix may be originated by multiple ASes (MOAS — Multiple Origin AS).

ip.description: Queried IP address in canonical form.

origins.description: AS numbers originating this prefix. More than one entry indicates a MOAS (Multiple Origin AS) prefix.

size.description: Number of IP addresses in the matched prefix. Decimal for IPv4, power-of-two notation for IPv6.

ASAnswer.description: Answer for an AS number query (as2prefix lookup). Prefixes are sorted: IPv4 ascending by network address, then IPv6 ascending by network address. Peers is the merged, deduplicated, ascending-sorted union of all BGP neighbours (peers, upstreams, and downstreams as classified by db2prefix).

prefixes.description: All BGP prefixes announced by this AS, each with its address count. Sorted: IPv4 ascending by network address, then IPv6 ascending.

peers.description: Merged, deduplicated, ascending-sorted union of all BGP neighbours (peers + upstreams + downstreams as classified by db2prefix). Absent if the AS has no known BGP neighbours.

PrefixInfo.description: A BGP prefix with its address count.

size.description: Number of IP addresses in this prefix. Decimal for IPv4 (e.g. "256"), power-of-two notation for IPv6 (e.g. "2^96").
